req.title: Redirect preserves relative or absolute style
req.statement: The system shall emit relative URLs on /redirect/<n> and absolute URLs on /absolute-redirect/<n>.
triggers: redirect preserves relative or absolute style

doc.reasoning: The requirement states that /redirect/<n> emits relative URLs and /absolute-redirect/<n> emits absolute URLs. I need to test: (1) positive case - relative redirect on /redirect/<n>, (2) positive case - absolute redirect on /absolute-redirect/<n>, (3) boundary case - n=1 (minimum valid value, special-cased in source), (4) boundary case - n=2 (just above minimum, exercises _redirect helper), (5) negative case - n=0 triggers assertion error (assert n > 0 in source), (6) decision table - ?absolute=true query param on /redirect/<n> forces absolute URL. Key mutations to kill: off-by-one on n, boolean flip on absolute flag, wrong URL style (relative vs absolute), wrong status code.

tests.name: test_redirect_n1_emits_relative_location
preconditions: n=1 is the minimum valid redirect count
expected: Location header starts with '/' (relative, not http://)
Location header does not start with 'http'
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_redirect_n1_emits_relative_location():
    r = client.get('/redirect/1', follow_redirects=False)
    assert r.status_code == 302
    location = r.headers['Location']
    assert location.startswith('/'), f'Expected relative URL, got: {location}'
    assert not location.startswith('http'), f'Expected relative URL, got: {location}'

test_redirect_n1_emits_relative_location()

tests.name: test_redirect_n0_returns_error
preconditions: n=0 violates assert n > 0 in source
expected: Response is not 2xx (assert n > 0 triggers 500 or 404)
trace: R-HTTPBIN-042: boundary below minimum; source has `assert n > 0` which raises AssertionError -> 500
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_redirect_n0_returns_error():
    r = client.get('/redirect/0', follow_redirects=False)
    assert r.status_code in (400, 404, 500), (
        f'Expected error status for n=0, got: {r.status_code}'
    )
    assert r.status_code != 302, 'n=0 must not produce a redirect'
    assert r.status_code != 200, 'n=0 must not produce a 200 OK'

test_redirect_n0_returns_error()

tests.name: test_redirect_with_absolute_query_param_emits_absolute_url

expected: Location header starts with 'http' (absolute URL despite using /redirect/ endpoint)

tests.name: test_redirect_full_chain_n2_ends_at_get
preconditions: Following all redirects from /redirect/2 should end at /get
trace: R-HTTPBIN-042: state transition - /redirect/2 -> /redirect/1 -> /get; final response is 200 JSON from view_get
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
import json
client = app.test_client()

def test_redirect_full_chain_n2_ends_at_get():
    r = client.get('/redirect/2', follow_redirects=True)
    assert r.status_code == 200
    data = json.loads(r.data)
    assert 'url' in data, f'Expected view_get JSON with url key, got: {data}'
    assert 'headers' in data, f'Expected view_get JSON with headers key, got: {data}'

test_redirect_full_chain_n2_ends_at_get()
